changelog: The Board Chips collection gets its full ornate look. The chip collection now opens from a proper 'CHIPS' plate in Settings, is crowned by a carved 'Board Chips' banner, and its two slots — MY UNITS and ENEMY UNITS — are now gilded plate tabs (the one you're editing glows gold, the other dims). Same collectible cosmetic system underneath: win chips as run rewards and equip one plaque for your army and a different one for the enemy.
